related.note: Both concern what kind of evidence the Nimitz Tic Tac encounter gives. Madden treats it as testimony from reliable witnesses, while the story calls it multisensory evidence.

plain: A philosopher, James Madden, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, uses the Tic Tac case as an example: a sighting by Navy pilots of a white oval object, shaped like the mint. He says his evidence for it is the word of seemingly very reliable pilots, naming Alex Dietrich and David Fravor, who have described what they saw. His point is that much of what we know about such encounters rests on trusting credible witnesses.
